{{Quote|Look, I can take you as far as Anchorhead. You can get a transport there to Mos Eisley or wherever you're going.|Luke Skywalker, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Anchorhead''' was one of the first settlements on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Abandoned and resettled many times, it lost significance until it was only a minor outpost for several nearby [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]] where youths such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friends spent much of their free time. The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] often referred to Anchorhead as "Old City New". Anchorhead was part of the [[Great Chott salt flat/Legends|Great Chott salt flat]] region.

==History==
{{Quote|Mos Eisley flourished after building starports as a viable alternative to Anchorhead, which many people at the time thought was too expensive.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
===Settlement===
Anchorhead was one of the oldest settlements on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tatooine. Located nearly 80 kilometers from [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], it was originally a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] outpost. It was abandoned and resettled many times, as each mining company came to discover the poor quality of the ore located there. The most notable of the mining operations was carried out by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] Corporation in [[3956 BBY]].

The companies would abandon their equipment each time, due to the prohibitive costs of transporting it off-world. The indigenous Jawas would take this abandoned equipment as their own. This gave rise to the use of [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawlers]]—mobile smelting machines—as well as mobile homes for the Jawas.

===Old Republic===
[[File:Anchorhead.jpg|thumb|left|Anchorhead during Revan's time]]
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his companions landed at Anchorhead in 3956 BBY. They hoped to locate a hidden [[Star Map]], a technological remnant of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], which would help them find the [[Star Forge]]. At the time, Czerka Corporation's mining operations were going poorly, as the ore was substandard and word was getting out. Though [[Motta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] established a [[Swoop racing/Legends|Swoop racing]] track and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Fazza Utral]] built a hunting lodge, attracting other forms of business to fill company coffers wasn't working, either. Worst of all, ore shipments were being intercepted and destroyed by frequent [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sandpeople]] attacks. Revan offered his assistance, and was able to earn the Tusken Raiders' trust, enough to negotiate with them. They would not agree to stop the attacks, but the Sand people did agree to ''reduce'' them, and to free some of their prisoners, including several Jawas and [[Mission Vao]]'s brother, [[Griff Vao]].<ref name="KotOR" />

Sometime after the ore operations ended, Czerka began a secret weapons research program on the planet. Czerka suddenly pulled out sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], leading the settlement to become a hive for smugglers and other criminals.

By the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it had been resettled, but [[City/Legends|cities]] like Mos Eisley and [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] had been built, and stripped the settlement of its preeminence.

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|The city of Anchorhead is in southern Tatooine. Rebels are known to congregate in Anchorhead.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sabol]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Lt. Sabol"}}</ref>}}
[[File:AnchorheadSWG.jpg|thumb|250px|The town of Anchorhead during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].]]
By the time of the Galactic Empire, Anchorhead, along with other settlements on Tatooine, had become populated again. It could be found a few miles east of the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], south of the now-bustling [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of Mos Eisley. Anchorhead itself primarily consisted of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]]. It was governed by the [[Anchorhead Municipal Council]]. The city became a place where many youth, including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friends, loved to visit and hang out.<ref name="Darklighter">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Darklighter]]''</ref>

Sometime after Biggs Darklighter left Tatooine, there was much unrest among the Tusken Raiders. They even raided the outskirts of Anchorhead.<ref name="EP4NOVEL">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> Anchorhead itself contained a dozen [[Pourstone/Legends|pourstone]] stores, two cantinas (including [[The Weary Traveler]]), a market, and [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] on the outskirts of town.

During the Galactic Civil war, the [[Anchorhead Base]] located in a canyon near the city served as a training facility for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilots. The base was destroyed during the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]].<ref name="RA" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the city itself became a Rebel Alliance stronghold.<ref name="GG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Anchorhead hosted a large [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration. A group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], including [[Kkatamik]], traveled to the city in order to spread the ideals of Life Day.<ref name="SWG:WLD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=event|Wookiee Life Day}}</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo stopped there to evade the Empire on their [[Mission to Tatooine (Killik Twilight)|quest]] to find a piece of Alderaan art, ''[[Killik Twilight]]''.<ref name="TG" />

==Inhabitants==
The following individuals were residents or visitors of the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin: [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze Loneozner]], [[Windy Starkiller]], [[Vardias Tyne]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Borra Setas]],<ref name="SWG:TTE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> [[Alger]], [[Cuan Talon]], [[Janus]], and [[Sorna]].<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> Rebel Alliance military staff included [[Aaph Koden]], [[Nitra Vendallan]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Carh'la Bastra]], [[Droma Ordo]],<ref name="SWG:SK" /> and [[Jarad Gastin]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Anchorhead_distance.jpg|thumb|200px|Anchorhead, from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Episode IV's'']] deleted scene]]
In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], Luke asks his uncle, [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], if he can see some of his friends there. In a deleted scene, Luke can be seen there with [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], who would later fight alongside Luke in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. These scenes were filmed at [[Sidi Jemour]] in [[Djerba]], [[Tunisia]].

In the [[LucasArts]] game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Anchorhead is described as a town in which those sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] can walk out in the open, and it is noted that "If there was any town on Tatooine that was the farthest from Imperial rule, Anchorhead would be the one."<ref name="SWG" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 15 December 04|Publish 11.5]]" on [[December 14]], [[2004]], Anchorhead was the host of the yearly in-game event known as the Wookiee Life Day.<ref name="P11.5">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=375|text=Update Notes - December 14, 2004 - Publish 11.5}}</ref> The Life Day event was later completely revamped and moved to other cities the subsequent years.<ref name="CLD">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67531&month=122007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Celebrating Life Day}}</ref>

In another game, ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'', Anchorhead Base is where pilot [[Rookie One]] trains on the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]. The base's main hangar opens into [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]], which served as a perfect flight training route.
